instrument: OMB Memorandum M-26-04, Increasing Public Trust in Artificial Intelligence Through Unbiased AI Principles
note: Counterfactual analytical application. The organisms are Apache-2.0; M-26-04 footnote 6 states agencies are not required to apply these requirements to LLMs acquired under a free open-source license, while encouraging due diligence. This is a documentary-coverage / evidentiary-yield assessment, NOT a compliance determination and NOT a detector-validity claim.

class_A_mandatory_minimum.detail: base identity, fine-tune relationship, resulting architecture and dtype documented; training objective, dataset, hyperparameters, methodology, and the fine-tuning party's identity are not; the omission is explicit and documented

class_B_conditional_enhanced.detail: chat template default system message is the unmodified upstream Qwen string; no organism-specific system instruction or conditional injection; covers disclosed configuration-layer conditioning only, unsupported for undisclosed weight-level activation
does not establish that a model favors that government; not mapped to favored principal

class_B_conditional_enhanced.field: Third-party modifications (vendor not the direct developer)
class_B_conditional_enhanced.detail: if publisher treated as third-party modifier of a base they did not develop: PARTIALLY_DISCLOSED (fine-tuning disclosed; objective/data/methodology not); if role unresolved: UNASSESSABLE; fine-tuning existence recorded at A2 regardless

result.favored_principal_status: UNRESOLVED across all sixteen fields — no M-26-04 field requires it
result.coding: single-coder profile against the M-26-04 text and the organizer-provided model documentation; not independently double-coded (see paper limitations)
